blind.description: A standalone fantasy-style circular metal or dark stone brazier filled with unlit charcoal chunks. It features a wide bowl with a thick rim supported by four or five vertical exterior brackets, resting on a cylindrical pedestal base with a dull reddish-brown decorative band and a flared stepped base ring. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly sculpted with a stylized hand-painted texture.
blind.from_above: A circular basin surrounded by a thick rounded rim with small rectangular brackets projecting radially, filled with textured grey and black lumps of charcoal.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 2.8 feet tall (roughly mid-thigh to waist height on the figure, around 45% of its height) and about 2.5 feet in diameter.
